summary: Build writing intelligence engine (F-004) and template/scaffold system (F-006) for M9 Phase 1
approach: Two parallel service layers (Wave 1) followed by two parallel UI layers (Wave 2). Intelligence service uses frontend-orchestrated analysis via existing gateway agent endpoints with filesystem-based caching. Template service provides CRUD for TipTap JSON templates with placeholder substitution. Both features are orthogonal and can be built independently.

data_flow.diagram: User clicks Analyze → intelligenceSlice dispatches → intelligenceService orchestrates chapter-by-chapter calls via agentGetContext/agentWrite gateway → results cached with content_hash → UI renders analysis panels
stages: intelligenceService reads all chapter contents from projectFileService
For each chapter, calls gateway agent with analysis prompt (character_arc/pacing/consistency/readability)
Results cached to Tauri filesystem with SHA-256 content_hash for invalidation
Template service reads built-in JSON + user templates from Tauri appDataDir
UI panels read from Zustand slices (intelligenceSlice, templateSlice)

design_decisions: Frontend-orchestrated analysis (no new sidecar endpoints) — intelligenceService calls existing gateway agent endpoints
Filesystem-based caching (not SQLite) — consistent with projectFileService pattern
TipTap JSON as template format — zero conversion when applying to editor
Built-in templates bundled as static JSON imports — user templates via Tauri appDataDir
On-demand analysis (user-triggered) — no auto-analysis on save
Chinese readability: adapted sentence/paragraph length ratio (no standard formula exists)

patterns: Zustand slice pattern: createXxxSlice in src/stores/app/, registered in appStore.ts
API calls: callApi() from src/api/core.ts with ApiResponse<T> wrapper
Content hashing: SHA-256 via crypto.subtle.digest in projectFileService.ts:hashContent()
conventions: Right panel type union in useAppUiPersistence.ts: RightPanelType
Lazy-loaded panels in AppRightPanels.tsx with Suspense fallback
Service files in src/services/, API files in src/api/
dependencies: agents.ts for gateway AI calls (agentGetContext, agentWrite)
projectSlice.ts for project/chapter data and addChapter()
